analysis: Integration pass over docs, tests and provider-swift deadline-admission changes. The changes add a DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES rollback switch, which is on by default and fixed to a small allowlist forward into the launchd plist (LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys). Other changes: per-batch-step decode pricing (CBv2DecodeRateShape), an isolated-prefill anchor with a 1/8 idle-rate floor and 30-minute stale-evidence expiry (IsolatedPrefillAdmissionRate.resolve), and newest-observation freshness anchoring in EnginePerformanceMeasurements.Rate (max(at, now)). These touch only provider-local TTFT/deadline admission, which is an availability and scheduling heuristic. They do not touch keys (A-002/A-003), E2E encryption (TB-002/T-008), attestation (TB-009), App Attest authorization (TB-011/T-053), the fan helper (TB-010) or prefix-cache storage (T-041: TTL, HMAC names, scope and AAD are unchanged). The env switch is operator-controlled local configuration inside ADV-001's existing control of its own provider process. Disabling it only reverts to the prior estimators. The tests confirm that other env vars such as UNRELATED_SECRET stay filtered and that the key is not forwarded to the watchdog. The wire schema is unchanged; sample_age_ms is an advisory, provider-self-reported freshness field, and the newest-observation anchor does not let an older completion rejuvenate evidence. Residual items I could not verify: (1) libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump 19634dd to 4b8a1bb is opaque (only hashes visible), so any KV-cache, memory or prefix-cache impact (T-041, T-028, TB-007) is unreviewed. That is the main reason for needs_deeper_review. (2) Callers consuming the new estimator helpers were not all visible. (3) Many source units were omitted from replay (103 omitted). The estimators could make admission more permissive when GPU load is contended, an availability and quality concern only.
